events.title: Wolfpire 0 demo is part of Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Try the opening of Wolfpire 0 in our free demo during the Steam Next Fest! From 19 to 26 October, escape from the manor where you've woken up and observe your surroundings carefully to spot any anomalies. The floorboards creak, the clock strikes, and you can even hear footsteps nearby. events.title: Wolfpire 0 is coming soon!
events.summary: Hello fellow anomalies hunters,We’re excited to finally introduce Wolfpire 0, an anomaly game inspired by French folklore and vampire legends where you have to observe your surroundings, spot any anomalies and find a way out from a mansion with endless corridors. Wolfpire 0 is designed as a troubling experience in PSX's style focused on spotting a pattern/anomaly in the objects and entities around you.
